items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: we were with the Alabama State Gabriel (unintelligible) wich was Erskine Hawkins

ctx.x: Well, now, we were with the Alabama State Gabriel (unintelligible) wich was Erskine Hawkins -- and still is Erskine Hawkins. And we was in Baltimore, Maryland, the home of the Harlem allstar, Baby Lawrence, and Chuckles' girlfriend was going to visit him -- his fiance, I should say, and he had gotten me to agree to be the best man. Now, the rumor got out

that he was going to become a husband -- at last. So, everybody that was in the show -- they loved Chuckles, see. He was that way, kind of infectious on people. So, he wanted to involve the audience, you know, and they wanted everybody to know that he was going to become a husband, you see. And so now (unintelligible) back stage that got in on him, so they said, "Well, why don't we get a -- we'll ride out front of the theater in taxis and the bus -- you know, a well, charter a bus, and the bride and groom and the…

because we grew up together, you see. All right, he had me, so what could I do. I had to bend over backwards, and that's what I did. So, like I'm saying, she was such a wonderful girl -- she still is. I think she's in Illinois or somewhere out there. She made Chuckles very happy. I'd never seen him that happy since we were children, you see. But, like I say, I went and explained to him that I wasn't going to be mingling with the public out in, you know, amongst people and they'd be questioning me and what are we…
